contracts.prompt_snippet: MACHINE CONTRACT (required): emit one fenced ```legal-inventory-json``` object with facts, assumptions, issues, and questions_for_counsel. Every issue names its trigger and evidence; do not present general information as legal advice.

MACHINE CONTRACT (required): emit one fenced ```legal-disposition-json``` object with concerns and release_disposition. Each concern names severity, blocking_concern, trigger, evidence, mitigation, owner, and clearance evidence. Separately emit one artifact-json legal_flag for each unresolved blocker; its body must name the blocking concern and the concrete condition for clearance.
